title: strkey.Decode with the claimable-balance version byte accepts an unknown type byte

target.versions_affected: v0.7.1 - v0.9.0 (executed: v0.7.1, v0.7.2, v0.7.3, v0.8.0, v0.9.0; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: Acceptance of invalid input: strkey.Decode, DecodeAny and IsValidClaimableBalance accept SEP-23 invalid vector 15, while the typed decoder xdr.ClaimableBalanceId.DecodeFromStrkey rejects it. No reader impact verified.
caps_note: No CAP applies: a SEP-23 strkey text rule, not a protocol change (the corpus's strkey group).

entries.expected: reject SEP-23 v1.4.0 invalid vector 15 (a claimable-balance strkey whose type byte is not a known ClaimableBalanceIDType)
entries.observed: Executed on v0.7.1, v0.7.2, v0.7.3, v0.8.0 and v0.9.0: strkey.Decode with the claimable-balance version byte checks only the 33-byte length and returns the payload with no error.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (make verify-conformance; xcc conform run --columns 'go@*' --entries 'strkey/sep-0023-v1.4.0-vectors.invalid-15'), L4, on every Go column.
evidence.expected_basis: SEP-23 v1.4.0 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/f2d364902615af726b3533021403c8b225aa6e5d/ecosystem/sep-0023.md) lists this vector as invalid (invalid vector 15).

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone: the listed report rows failed again as recorded, offline. Checked again by hand on v0.9.0 (2026-11-13) before filing.

approval.scope: Public issue on stellar/go-stellar-sdk (#6042): strkey.Decode / DecodeAny / IsValidClaimableBalance accept SEP-23 invalid-15 while xdr.ClaimableBalanceId.DecodeFromStrkey rejects it.

history.note: Created from the conformance run's failure rows; no public upstream item found.
Reproduced, upstream searched (none found), issue text written; awaiting a maintainer's review before filing.

Filed by the maintainers of this kit as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6042, on v0.9.0 and main 376279e, framed as the inconsistency between the raw strkey path and the xdr path. No pull request (the repository takes pull requests by invitation).
